question: King Asoka of the Mauryan Empire was a follower of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhism**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• King Asoka, also known as Ashoka the Great, was a prominent emperor of the Mauryan Empire who ruled from 268 to 232 BCE.
 
• He is most famously known for his conversion to **Buddhism** after the Kalinga War, which led to a period of immense change in his reign.
 
• Asoka's embrace of Buddhism had a profound impact on the spread of the religion throughout Asia.
